selection:

  ParentCommandLine|contains: ' /c '
  Image|endswith: '\chcp.com'
  CommandLine|endswith: 'chcp'
condition: selection
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\cmd.exe" ParentCommandLine="* /c *" Image="*\\chcp.com" CommandLine="*chcp"
